newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures seen set for more gains.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures seen set for more gains.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei stock index futures ended firmer on Friday and looked poised for more gains next week, dealers said.
"Today's was a very good close, not only on a daily basis but also on a weekly basis," said one Singaporean dealer. "It was a beautiful close and it should go higher technically."
The lead Nikkei 225 June contract closed up 330 points at 20,375 on 12,500 lots. The contract earlier reached an intraday high of 20,400 points.
Dealers said June had solid technical chart support at 19,950 points and also a psychological barrier at 20,000.
It should head up towards 20,500 early next week, they said.
"From here on the next target is 20,500 and I think the longer-term range could prove to be 20,000 to 22,000 points," said another dealer.

"The only thing that could upset this now is if the yen fell further, but I think it has now stabilised against the dollar. I believe it can hold around these levels for the next one or two weeks provided we don't have any dramatic news," he said.
The May MSCI Taiwan index contract rose 9.2 points to settle at 346.3 against its opening 337.5 on volume of 1659 lots.
